understanding: The acquired source establishes a synchronous protocol dispatch loop with independent timer, client-connection and optional execution goroutines. Proposal handling rejects nonleaders, batches queued proposals for leaders, chooses an instance ballot, and branches between prepare broadcast and local acceptance followed by accept broadcast. Broadcast helpers select peers through Alive and PreferredPeerOrder. Commit broadcast passes a full Commit object under commitShortRPC; its wire interpretation remains unknown without registration and serialization code. These observations describe local actions, not decision, durability or delivery guarantees.

delta.rationale: Expand only the selected frontier using attached code. Separate the timer owner, proposal rejection and the two proposal progression branches. Retain local ballot selection and local acceptance as distinct weak facts. Broadcast and reply calls establish no delivery, persistence or decision facts. Preserve the observed full Commit pointer passed under commitShortRPC as an unresolved transport interpretation, not a confirmed defect. Other responsibility classes and adjacent handler lifecycles remain outside this bounded expansion.
